description: Pre-install hook for AWS-RunPatchBaselineWithHooks: snapshots every EBS volume attached to the instance before patching.

runCommand: if [ -z "$INSTANCE_ID" ] || [ -z "$REGION" ]; then echo "ERROR: Could not retrieve instance ID or region from metadata service."; exit 1; fi

SNAPSHOT_IDS=$(aws ec2 create-snapshots --region "$REGION" --instance-specification "InstanceId=$INSTANCE_ID,ExcludeBootVolume=false" --description "Pre-patch snapshot of $INSTANCE_NAME ($INSTANCE_ID) - $DATE" --tag-specifications "ResourceType=snapshot,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=${INSTANCE_NAME}-prepatch-${DATE}},{Key=Purpose,Value=Patching},{Key=Retention,Value=30}]" --query "Snapshots[].SnapshotId" --output text)
if [ -z "$SNAPSHOT_IDS" ] || [ "$SNAPSHOT_IDS" = "None" ]; then echo "ERROR: No snapshots created for $INSTANCE_ID."; exit 1; fi
